room_rent.note: Policy covers hospital room rent with no stated sub-limit or cap on room category

icu.note: ICU charges covered under in-patient benefit with no stated cap

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the base policy

sub_limits.note: Ambulance capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation; Recovery Benefit ₹10,000 lumpsum; Worldwide Emergency Care capped at 50% of SI up to ₹20L; no disease-wise sub-limits on main in-patient cover

deductible.note: Deductible is optional; options are ₹2L, ₹3L, ₹5L, ₹10L (₹10L only for SI ≥ ₹20L). Base plan has no deductible.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing disease waiting period is 36 months; reducible via portability credit

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.) have 24-month waiting period

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Code Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: Multiplier Benefit: 50% of basic SI added per policy year irrespective of claims, max 100% of basic SI

restoration.note: Restore Benefit triggers after basic SI + Multiplier Benefit fully exhausted; available once per policy year; cannot be used for same illness/disease already claimed in that year (family floater: same illness by different member is allowed)

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days before admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days after discharge

day_care.note: All day-care procedures covered as per schedule of benefits

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary treatment covered; minimum 3-day treatment required (expenses for first 3 days covered only if total treatment exceeds 3 days)

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals; treatment outside India excluded

organ_donor.note: Medical and surgical expenses for organ harvesting covered when insured is recipient; donor's pre/post-hospitalisation expenses excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance cover limited to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation for emergency transport

modern_treatments.note: Policy wording does not explicitly mention modern/robotic treatments as a named benefit or exclusion

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items (gloves, nebuliser kit, etc.) are explicitly excluded per the Non-Medical Expenses annexure; no rider available

global_cover.note: Worldwide Emergency Care is inbuilt; covers emergency hospitalisation abroad; capped at 50% of SI up to ₹20L; reimbursement only

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years no look-back applied; claims not contestable except fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 30 days for non-monthly premium modes; 15 days for monthly instalment mode

free_look.note: Free-look period of 30 days from receipt of policy document; applicable on new policies only

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, infertility/ART, congenital external anomalies, stem cell harvesting, OPD treatment, dental (unless hospitalised), sleep apnoea investigation, alcoholic cirrhosis (permanent)
